title: NIST WebBook: Benzene is C6H6, molecular weight 78.1118 amu
summary: The NIST Chemistry WebBook lists Benzene as C6H6, molecular weight 78.1118 amu, CAS 71-43-2.
body: The NIST Chemistry WebBook entry for Benzene, CAS Registry Number 71-43-2, lists molecular formula C6H6 and molecular weight 78.1118 amu. The same entry's monoisotopic molecular weight is 78.0469502 amu. The IUPAC InChI on the entry is InChI=1S/C6H6/c1-2-4-6-5-3-1/h1-6H. The molecular weight and the monoisotopic mass are two different fields. This card reports the catalog entry. It does not convert either field into a molar mass in grams, and it does not say that every real sample has that weight.
